Operator.Edge.Canny.Name: Canny Edge Detection
Operator.Edge.Canny.Description: Detects thin binary edges using gradient magnitude, non-maximum suppression, and dual-threshold hysteresis. Use it when a clean connected edge map is required.
Operator.Edge.Sobel.Name: Sobel Directional Gradient
Operator.Edge.Sobel.Description: Computes a first-order directional derivative with a Sobel kernel. Select the X and Y derivative orders to inspect horizontal or vertical intensity changes; the output is a gradient image, not a closed contour.
Operator.Edge.Scharr.Name: Scharr Accurate Gradient
Operator.Edge.Scharr.Description: Computes a first-order derivative with a 3×3 Scharr kernel. It is generally more rotationally accurate than Sobel at the same kernel size.
Operator.Edge.Laplacian.Name: Laplacian Edge Detection
Operator.Edge.Laplacian.Description: Computes a direction-independent second-order derivative and emphasizes rapid intensity changes. It is more noise-sensitive than first-order gradients, so smoothing is usually recommended first.
Operator.Contour.Moments.Name: Contour Moments
Operator.Contour.Moments.Description: Calculates spatial and central moments for the primary contour. Moments support area, centroid, orientation, and derived shape features; they are unrelated to rectangles.
